summary.text: Debra Entenman is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 47-Position 1, where she has served since January 2019, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She previously served as District Director for U.S. Representative Adam Smith.

paragraphs.text: Debra Entenman is the daughter of a Seattle teacher and, according to the House Democrats' biography, was an inaugural member of the Seattle/King County Head Start program.
She returned to school after her own children were ready for college, studying political science at Highline Community College and Seattle University.
She then served as District Director for Congressman Adam Smith and was appointed to the Board of Trustees at Renton Technical College in 2015.
Entenman took office in the House on January 14, 2019, succeeding Mark Hargrove.
The biography describes her as passionate about education for people of all ages, and says she lives in Kent with her husband.
